prefs.title: Notification Settings
prefs.muteSubhead: Turn off pushes for the kinds of updates you don't want.
prefs.quietSubhead: No pushes during these hours (India time).
prefs.quietWrapNote: Spans midnight if 'From' is later than 'To'.
prefs.capSubhead: Most pushes you'll get in any 24-hour window.
prefs.allMutedNote: All categories are muted — you won't get any pushes. You'll still see updates in the app.
